hypotheses.title: Evidence-aware local model routing
hypotheses.mechanism: Use verification and artifact evidence to update local model confidence.
hypotheses.expectedBenefit: Increase controlled independence and reduce hidden external dependence.
hypotheses.failureArgument: Can overfit to small local benchmarks.
hypotheses.experiment: Replay task set and compare unsafe failure rate.
hypotheses.successCriteria: At least 10% safer routing with no >10% quality loss.

hypotheses.title: Federated local memory
hypotheses.mechanism: Exchange signed memory deltas without central service.
hypotheses.expectedBenefit: Increase controlled independence and reduce hidden external dependence.
hypotheses.failureArgument: Conflict and deletion semantics can corrupt authority.
hypotheses.experiment: Two-node offline merge with contradiction reporting.
hypotheses.successCriteria: No silent overwrite or cross-tenant import.
hypotheses.killCriteria: Kill until version-vector and deletion semantics are explicit.

hypotheses.title: Confidence-decaying procedural memory
hypotheses.mechanism: Reduce authority of stale procedures automatically.
hypotheses.expectedBenefit: Increase controlled independence and reduce hidden external dependence.
hypotheses.experiment: Ablation against stale and current procedures.
hypotheses.successCriteria: Unsafe stale use drops materially without excessive false negatives.

hypotheses.title: Energy-aware task deferral
hypotheses.mechanism: Delay non-urgent work under high power or thermal pressure.
hypotheses.expectedBenefit: Increase controlled independence and reduce hidden external dependence.
hypotheses.experiment: Simulated workload under seven energy policies.
hypotheses.successCriteria: Energy budget met and deadlines respected.
hypotheses.killCriteria: Kill if deferral is opaque or starvation occurs.

hypotheses.title: Offline signed agent handoffs
hypotheses.mechanism: Move bounded tasks and evidence across an air gap.
hypotheses.expectedBenefit: Increase controlled independence and reduce hidden external dependence.
hypotheses.failureArgument: Key loss, replay, and scope escalation.
hypotheses.experiment: Export, execute, sign, import, tamper, expire, cross-tenant tests.
hypotheses.successCriteria: Valid result imports; all scope escalation fails closed.
hypotheses.killCriteria: Kill if result cannot bind exact task hash.

hypotheses.title: Reconciliation-first external actions
hypotheses.mechanism: Assume uncertain external outcomes require reconciliation before retry.
hypotheses.expectedBenefit: Increase controlled independence and reduce hidden external dependence.
hypotheses.experiment: Inject timeout after side effect across tool classes.
hypotheses.killCriteria: Kill if reconciliation cannot be resolved safely.

hypotheses.title: Local verifier quorum
hypotheses.mechanism: Require two or more independent local attestations.
hypotheses.expectedBenefit: Increase controlled independence and reduce hidden external dependence.
hypotheses.successCriteria: Quorum rejects mismatch and shared identity.
hypotheses.killCriteria: Kill if all verifiers depend on same mutable context.

hypotheses.title: Multi-node model specialization
hypotheses.mechanism: Route planning, coding, and verification to specialized local nodes.
hypotheses.expectedBenefit: Increase controlled independence and reduce hidden external dependence.
hypotheses.successCriteria: Higher quality/cost utility with no tenant violation.
hypotheses.killCriteria: Kill if synchronization cost exceeds benefit.

hypotheses.title: Adaptive quantization selection
hypotheses.mechanism: Choose model quantization by RAM, quality, and energy budget.
hypotheses.expectedBenefit: Increase controlled independence and reduce hidden external dependence.
hypotheses.failureArgument: Quantization quality metadata may be unreliable.
hypotheses.experiment: Benchmark two quantizations on same tasks/hardware.
hypotheses.successCriteria: Meet quality floor with lower energy or latency.
hypotheses.killCriteria: Kill if benchmark confidence is insufficient.

hypotheses.title: Sovereignty-aware context assembly
hypotheses.mechanism: Exclude evidence that would require remote disclosure or violate locality.
hypotheses.expectedBenefit: Increase controlled independence and reduce hidden external dependence.
hypotheses.experiment: Compare local-only and mixed context on restricted tasks.
hypotheses.successCriteria: No prohibited disclosure with acceptable quality floor.
hypotheses.killCriteria: Kill if restricted context still leaks through derived data.

hypotheses.title: Air-gap evidence transfer
hypotheses.mechanism: Move only signed hashes and minimum evidence across nodes.
hypotheses.expectedBenefit: Increase controlled independence and reduce hidden external dependence.
hypotheses.experiment: Verify release with partial and full evidence bundles.
hypotheses.killCriteria: Kill if verifier requires hidden builder summary.

hypotheses.title: Privacy-preserving local telemetry summaries
hypotheses.mechanism: Export aggregate health without raw user data.
hypotheses.expectedBenefit: Increase controlled independence and reduce hidden external dependence.
hypotheses.failureArgument: Aggregates can still re-identify small populations.
hypotheses.experiment: Differential privacy or minimum cohort experiment.
hypotheses.killCriteria: Kill if summaries expose individual task behavior.

hypotheses.title: Immutable local release evidence
hypotheses.mechanism: Bind every release gate to a Merkle-style local evidence root.
hypotheses.expectedBenefit: Increase controlled independence and reduce hidden external dependence.
hypotheses.experiment: Modify one evidence file after freeze.
hypotheses.killCriteria: Kill if evidence root cannot be reproduced.

hypotheses.title: Self-auditing network boundaries
hypotheses.mechanism: Every adapter declares and reports network intent.
hypotheses.expectedBenefit: Increase controlled independence and reduce hidden external dependence.
hypotheses.failureArgument: Hidden native or browser traffic may bypass application guards.
hypotheses.experiment: Run app guard plus process-level packet audit.
hypotheses.killCriteria: Kill sovereign pilot if full audit cannot run.

hypotheses.title: Recovery simulation before execution
hypotheses.mechanism: Predict recovery state before risky action.
hypotheses.expectedBenefit: Increase controlled independence and reduce hidden external dependence.
hypotheses.experiment: Compare predicted vs injected failure states.
